name: dsh-workbuddy-connect
description: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
author: corrinehu

patches.name: conversation trio
patches.summary: Chat requests carry X-Conversation-ID / -Request-ID / -Message-ID as fresh UUIDs per request.
patches.reason: Since 2026-10-16 the international gateway answers 400 / 11128 to any chat without the trio. Verified 2026-10-27: any one or two of the three still fail; all three pass; X-Agent-* is irrelevant. Fresh ids per request match upstream 0.7.9 (issue #139) and avoid relating a conversation id to a tool set that sub-agents change.
patches.verified: Both products HTTP 200 through the plugin's own client and its loopback shim; China unaffected.

patches.name: failure capture
patches.summary: A refused chat writes $DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-chat-failure.json with model, tool names, status and upstream body.
patches.reason: A refusal message alone does not identify the payload; the request body never reaches a log. No message content is written.

patches.name: daily check-in (China build)
patches.summary: Adds fetchCheckinStatus and claimDailyCheckin to the upstream client, on the billing host it already uses.
patches.reason: The vendored 0.7.3 has no check-in surface. Both endpoints answer on billingBase with billingHeaders; measured 2026-10-28 the China account reports active:true with a 14-day streak and the international build reports active:false.
patches.safety: The claim mutates the account (real reward). It is reachable only from a user click; the Host re-reads the status first, is single-flight per product, and invalidates the cached credit reading.

patches.name: normalize the China chat body
patches.summary: prepareCnChatBody now forces stream, rewrites role developer to system, and flattens an object tool_choice — the three repairs only the international path made.
patches.reason: Measured 2026-10-29 on a signed-in China account: a developer-role message returns 400/11128 'Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel' (the page's 「请求被拦截，请重新发送」, which is why it looked like the earlier channel-verification failure), and an object tool_choice returns 400/11101 'cannot unmarshal object into Go struct field Request.tool_choice of type string'. Both are exactly what prepareChatBody fixes.
